messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: router-service-eu-west p99 latency breach detected (p99=1.9s, SLO=1.5s). Spike start ~1799998987. Streaming stalls observed. Paging @lina (oncall) :rotating_light:

lina (oncall): acked. I'm pulling the routing table + active LB configs now. anyone seeing any traffic pattern anomalies?

alex (eng-runtime): seeing a routing-policy rollout (policy:v2) that changed seed mapping last night. Hash distribution looks skewed — shard-7 getting ~46% of routed sessions for short sequences. suspected hot partition + weight misassignment.

maria (observability): heatmap: https://dash.redwood/internal/heatmaps/router-service/eu-west?ts=1799998987 — clear hotband on shard-7, p99 delta aligns with spike. streaming stalls correlate with requests that had long prefix tokens.

reza (sre): initial mitigation options: 1) revert policy:v2 -> v1, 2) apply emergency weight override to reduce shard-7 weight, 3) drain & scale shard-7 pool, 4) fallback routing to cached model variant. Which do we want first?

lina (oncall): do we have an automated rollback? If it's destructive, prefer weighted override + scale. Revert only if override fails.

alex (eng-runtime): we can push an emergency override: `rbctl routing set-weight --policy policy:v2 --shard shard-7=0.05` will force ~5% to that shard and redistribute. I can run that. Also check `routing-seed` in config: appears the seed used in rollout job was different by one bit which caused bucket collision.

maria (observability): stacking trace samples: 
```
trace-id: 0x7fa2
route: /v1/generate -> shard-7
latency: 2.1s
last-hop: lb-euw2-12
```
multiple traces show last-hop stuck on a small subset of backends.

jordan (support): partial customer impact: 8 sessions reported streaming stalls > 2s in last 10m. Top accounts: AcmeCorp (prod), BetaChat (staging). I'll alert TSEs and mark as potential SLA exposure for AcmeCorp.

lina (oncall): alex — please run the override. reza — prep a drain/scale plan for shard-7. maria keep dashboards on refresh every 10s. ops-bot please create incident ticket if not already.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1759. Pager duty: oncall assigned to lina, escalation to rishabh in 30m.

alex (eng-runtime): running override now: `rbctl routing set-weight --policy policy:v2 --shard shard-7=0.05 --reason "emergency override, hotpartition"`

alex (eng-runtime): override applied. new distribution should converge in ~15-30s.

maria (observability): heatmap update 30s post-override: shard-7 load down to ~8% of traffic. p99 dropped from 1.9s -> 1.2s across eu-west. Streaming stalls reduced but some tail still at ~1.6s.

reza (sre): starting drain+scale: `infractl pool scale --pool shard-7-pool --replicas +3` and `infractl drain --pool shard-7-pool --grace 30s` to avoid connection churn. Will monitor connection backlog.

lina (oncall): enabling streaming fallback for affected routes to older stable routing path to mitigate long-tail streaming stalls: `featureflag set streaming.fallback.router-v1 on --scope eu-west`

jordan (support): notifying customers now: sent initial status to AcmeCorp SRE and BetaChat PM. message: "We observed transient streaming stalls in eu-west, mitigation in progress, updates every 10m."

maria (observability): telemetry snapshot: p95 now 420ms, p99 1.1s. error rate unchanged. Looks like fix is effective but we need to watch for ripple effects (e.g., additional shards heating up).

alex (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: rollout job used different RNG seed when seeding the consistent-hash table, producing a high-collision mapping that concentrated hot keys into shard-7. Should be fixed by aligning seed logic and adding a pre-rollout histogram check.

reza (sre): I see backlog on shard-9 starting to creep up — probably traffic redistribution. scaling shard-9 by +2 to be safe.

lina (oncall): handing off in 25m to rishabh. rishabh, I'll leave the override active until we validate the seed fix and rollout sanity checks. Please coordinate final rollback or canary re-deploy with Alex.

rishabh (oncall-next): taking over in 25m. noted the override and fallback flags. will confirm agent to run a canary rollout after we patch the seed mismatch.

alex (eng-runtime): creating a quick patch PR for rollout tooling with explicit `seed` param and preflight histogram assert. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/8421 — owner: alex.

maria (observability): creating a dashboard panel for 'hash-collision skew' and an alert to detect >30% of traffic landing on single shard for >2m.

jordan (support): final customer note queued for 30m update. no escalations requested yet.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigation applied (weight override + scaling + fallback). p99 reduced below SLO. On-call handoff planned: lina -> rishabh. Incident ticket INC-2026-1759.

lina (oncall): summary for postmortem: rollout seed mismatch produced hot partition (shard-7). mitigation: emergency weight override, scale/drain, streaming fallback. Customer impact: intermittent streaming stalls for small set of accounts, notified. Next steps: patch rollout tooling, add preflight histograms, add alerting.

alex (eng-runtime): agree. I'll own the rollout fix and coordinate with rishabh for safe re-deploy.

maria (observability): I'll own the post-incident dashboard + add the new alert.

reza (sre): will add a runbook entry for emergency weight override and safer drain sequence.

jordan (support): I'll reconcile customer messages and add notes to ticket.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1759 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Update: please file postmortem within 72h.

rishabh (oncall-next): taking charge. thanks team. I'll schedule a quick live-run with runtime + rollout owner to validate seed patch before any new rollouts.

lina (oncall): handing off — resolved for now, watching.

incident-bot: Thread closed for new page. Keep updates in INC-2026-1759."
